title: Stop Saying "Very Short": 10 Better Words to Use
description:
Stop saying "very short" and use one of these 10 better English words instead. You get five words for a short time and five words for short texts and short answers. Every word comes with a picture, a clear meaning and an example sentence. After each set of five words, you test yourself with a quick quiz and practise speaking by repeating the example sentences out loud after me.

Chapters
0:00 Intro
0:10 A short time
1:02 Speaking practice: a short time
1:31 Short texts and answers
2:25 Speaking practice: short texts and answers
3:02 Your turn

The 10 words
A short time: brief, quick, fleeting, momentary, short-lived
Short texts and answers: concise, succinct, terse, snappy, pithy

Which word will you use next time? Write it in the comments.

Find another word for any word on anotherwordfor.net
